components.title: compliant-s3
components.description: Reusable Terraform pattern for an AWS S3 primary bucket plus a dedicated access-log bucket. Hardcodes server-side encryption, versioning, public access block, access logging, and required compliance tags.
components.purpose: Provide a compliant-by-default S3 primitive that any team can adopt with three lines of consumer Terraform.

control-implementations.description: Implementation of NIST 800-53 Rev 5 controls satisfied by this module, enforced continuously by the grc-gate CI pipeline (Lab 4.3) and evidenced by signed, vaulted bundles (Lab 4.4).

implemented-requirements.description: AES-256 server-side encryption is enforced via aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration on both the primary and log buckets. Hardcoded; consumers cannot override.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle (run 31520511303) containing terraform plan.json, conftest-results.json, and tfsec.sarif. Verify with scripts/verify-evidence.sh 31520511303.

implemented-requirements.description: Public access is blocked via aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block with all four flags set true on both buckets, and Conftest's ac3_no_public_aws.rego policy enforces this at the CI gate on every pull request.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle (run 31520511303) containing terraform plan.json, conftest-results.json, and tfsec.sarif. Verify with scripts/verify-evidence.sh 31520511303.

implemented-requirements.description: Access logging is enabled via aws_s3_bucket_logging, directing access records to a dedicated, versioned log bucket separate from the primary bucket.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle (run 31520511303) containing terraform plan.json, conftest-results.json, and tfsec.sarif. Verify with scripts/verify-evidence.sh 31520511303.

implemented-requirements.description: Required compliance tags (environment, owner, data-classification, control-framework) are enforced on every taggable resource and validated by Conftest's cm6_required_tags_aws.rego policy at the CI gate.
